reason: A DSH Web plugin that monitors configured model-provider quotas and balances, periodically refreshes read-only usage data, and presents compact indicators with detailed status panels.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏显示并定期刷新多个模型 Provider 的订阅额度、限流窗口和账户余额详情。
summaries.en: Displays and periodically refreshes subscription quotas, rate-limit windows, and account balance details for configured model providers in the DSH Web sidebar.

capabilities: Reads configured provider credential references through the DSH credentials service
Queries supported provider quota and balance endpoints using HTTP GET requests
Displays normalized quota, usage, balance, reset, and error information in the DSH Web interface
Exposes quota data through a local HTTP endpoint
Refreshes provider data periodically and after conversation turns
